title: Playpex plugin API (SERVER_PLUGIN_API 1): what crosses the sandbox
description: Values the host hands to a plugin's handlers and what it accepts back (docs/plugins-plan.md §4–§5, author guide docs/plugins/). The host validates every answer of a plugin against these before using it; an answer that doesn't match counts as the handler failing. Hook i/o is under $defs/hooks/<name>/{input,output}.

context.description: Who a call is for. No tokens, no names of other profiles. profile is null for jobs and server-scope calls

titleRef.description: Which title: a movie, a show, an episode of one (tmdbId is the show's), or another video of the library

source.description: What a plugin's play.collect (or a play effect) offers. magnet: played as the core's torrents; http: an HTTPS file proxied by the server as a media ref r_…, the client never sees the URL

headers.description: Sent by the server with every request of this stream (a token): never to the client. Host, Cookie, Connection, Range, Content-Length and Transfer-Encoding are the server's (FORBIDDEN_HEADERS in plugins.js)

rankedSource.description: What play.rank sees of each source (the core's and plugins'): no magnet, path, URL or ref

url.description: Fetched by the core (its host must be in permissions.network), converted to WebVTT

end.description: seconds; credits may leave it out (until the end)

intent.description: A screen to open: plugin.<own id>.<name> or a core screen a plugin may open (core.movie, core.show, core.episode, core.search)

call.description: A data handler of the same plugin, called with these args when the user selects (actions, cards) or scrolls near the end (paged rows)

image.description: A full HTTPS URL, or assets/… of the package

info.description: The title info shown while the card has the focus (catalog template)

page.description: Paged: the core calls this handler with args.page = 1, 2… and expects a rowPage

icon.description: A core icon name, or assets/… of the package

playRequest.description: What the play effect hands to the core: one source plays at once, several open the source picker. tracking none: no resume point, progress, history, watched mark, Up next, playback events or download title (forced for audience adults)

effect.description: What the core does for a plugin on a client: a plugin never runs code there (§5.3)

target.description: screen (the plugin's open screen) or a slot name

dataAnswer.description: What a data handler answers: the model its template / slot / action expects, and effects to perform after it

templates.description: The data each screen template expects (P1 may add fields; never removes)

event.description: One event delivered to a plugin (§4.4): at most once, in order; dropped counts events lost to a full queue before this one

by.description: user, or plugin:<id> when another plugin made the change

source.description: Never the magnet, path or ref

output.description: order: ids first in this order, the rest after in their order; hide: dropped, with the reason the picker shows
check: which hashes it can serve ({ <hash>: { cached, label } }); resolve: an http source for the chosen one, or null

kind.description: movie, show, episode (the core's Find releases) or a kind of the plugin's own releases screens

slots.description: What a slot contribution's data handler answers in data, by the kind of slot (SLOTS in plugins.js)

libraryFile.description: What library.match sees of a file: its path relative to the library folder, the core's parse of it and the ids its nfo / tags gave; never the folder's path or the file's content

parse.description: lib/library/parse.js's answer: kind, title, year, season, episode, episodeEnd, resolution, source, codec

identity.description: Which title a library file is, on the core's kinds

notification.description: notify.send's message: a toast on the profiles' clients (kept 24 h for clients not connected; one per key, the newest wins)

linkStart.description: What a custom link handler answers (the dashboard shows it): a code to enter elsewhere and the handler to poll, or a form to fill
